items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE vs LAC. Risk/reward RB2; starting him everywhere as Cards wouldn't activate if worried about ankle. Some risk remains.
items.why: Expected to play per beat/insiders; confirmed active
items.implication: Startable RB2 with upside in potentially expanded role

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) officially active today vs CAR. Expected to play per weekend reports.
items.why: Calf issue but expected and confirmed active
items.implication: Full WR role in CHI offense with Williams
items.opportunity: Targets/routes as key piece post-Moore trade

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play and confirmed inactive vs DET. Status affects projections for Travis Etienne and others in NO backfield.
items.why: MCL sprain; full participant late week but not ready per reports
items.implication: Etienne unchallenged lead back; Miller RB2 upside

items.text: Weekend summary: Love (ankle) and Odunze (calf) expected; Kamara (knee) not; Josh Williams activated (Tucker doubtful); Nabers (knee) no news yet.
items.implication: Core inactive window intel for lineup locks

items.text: Ravens ruled out rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury.
items.implication: BAL WR depth chart shift; Flowers/others more snaps
items.opportunity: Increased targets to Zay Flowers, remaining WRs

items.text: Starting Jeremiyah Love everywhere as ACTIVE risk/reward RB2. Cards activating signals confidence despite ankle.
Patriots WR AJ Brown high ankle sprain: no surgery needed, sidelined 4-6 weeks. Not IR yet.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed no surgery
items.implication: NE WR depth elevated short-term; hold or stash Brown

items.text: Josh Jacobs remains on Commissioner Exempt list. NFL could count time as served toward potential DV suspension (CBA 6-game min possible).
Brock Bowers OUT Week 1 after meniscus trim Tuesday. Raiders believe realistic chance miss only one game, return Week 2 at LAC. Monitor feel this week.
items.implication: Mayer elevated TE1 Week 1; Bowers stash with W2 hope

items.text: Kamara's inactive status directly boosts Travis Etienne projection in NO-DET game.
items.why: No Kamara means full Etienne opportunity
items.implication: Start Etienne with confidence as lead back

items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) situation murky for SNF; up to him. Main slate news locked. Giants elevated Berrios and Cambre from PS. Projections updating live; only major potential change.
items.why: Full practice but readiness uncertain; PS elevations signal caution
items.implication: If out, WR elevation targets; if in, high upside SNF
items.opportunity: If active, primary target share; if OUT, Berrios/Cambre/others

items.text: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive (back) vs ATL amid contract dispute; trade possibility remains.
items.implication: PIT secondary depth; matchup notes for ATL pass game

items.text: Rams DE Myles Garrett arthroscopic knee surgery, placed on IR, min 4 games (Giants, Broncos, Eagles, Bills). Aaron Donald possible return next week.
items.implication: LAR defensive snaps shift; limited fantasy offensive impact

items.text: Roughly all news for main slate locked. No major projection changes expected beyond Nabers. Projections live and updating.
items.implication: Lock lineups on known actives; monitor SNF

items.text: Chuba Hubbard viable flex this week; keeping it open on The Chubbler.
items.why: Viable flex play in CAR backfield
items.implication: Flex consideration amid CAR RB questions

items.text: Pace notes from Thorman: NO @ DET up-tempo; MIA @ LV slow slog. Full Week 1 snaps & pace available.
items.implication: Higher play volume NO-DET favors skill players if Kamara out
